title: Sequence Viewer
text: Display messages, events, states, transitions, and functions between blocks during simulation; {Time Precision for Variable Step} sets the digits for time increment precision and {History} sets the maximum number of previous events. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Time Precision for Variable Step
params.values: Digits for time increment precision 3 (default) | scalar

params.name: History
params.values: Maximum number of previous events to display 5000 (default) | scalar
